topic: checking balanced parentheses with a stack
hook: How does a computer check if your brackets actually match? One stack.

narration.text: A stack only ever lets you touch the item on top — last in, first out.
Every opening bracket gets pushed onto the stack.
Every closing bracket checks the top of the stack — if it matches, pop it off.
Every push found a matching pop, and the stack ended empty — the brackets are balanced.

youtube.title: Checking Balanced Brackets With a Stack
youtube.description: How a stack checks whether brackets are balanced — push on every opener, pop and match on every closer.
